title: INIU 45W 10000mAh Power Bank with Built-in Cable $18.20 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ INIU AU via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: INIU 45W 10000mAh Power Bank with Built-in Cable $18.20 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ INIU AU via Amazon AU

[hiya] how long does these deals last? this post was posted 7 mins ago and i just checked on amazon and price is already back to $35?!
[bashar20] Are all the models in table comparable besides different dimensions. Or are some 10,000mah 45w better than the rest?
[RichardL] All 10,000mah, but mixture of 15W, 22.5W and 45W.
[bashar20] I already have the 22.5w one. Got this 45w one too.
Is this the good 45w one? Or is there a better one? I recall cable was detachable. But seems this one is built in.
[Hoosein 786] I ordered 3 and only paid $18.19 each with promotional discounts
[RichardL] $0.01 discount from the title (I'm assuming due to rounding off).
[pencilman] This is a better size and weight for most people. Enough to take daily and top up phone on the road quickly.
The 20,000 mAh one is twice the weight and not so easy to take around
[RichardL] I just notice that the Item Details has 2 different model number:
Model Name: P61L-E1
Model Number: P55L
Based on a quick Google, both looks identical with the difference being input/output.
P61L-E1 is 20W, whereas P55L is 45W.
I suspect INIU just reused their old listing but forgot to update the model as the title and all other images indicates 45W.
[babolat360] I refreshed at checkout and seems to be full price again
[Horacio] Just got this lined up in my cart then realised I already have one with same specs. FFS
